name: Paavan Shah
headline: Robotics Engineer • Satellite Systems • Autonomous Navigation • Wireless Sensor Networks
about: I am a Robotics and Embedded Firmware Engineer with practical experience in autonomous navigation, real-time control, multi-sensor embedded systems, and scientific instrumentation.

My background includes developing ROS2-based robotic systems, hardware debugging, and C/C++ firmware development. I have built complete systems from the ground up, including an award-winning 8-wheeled autonomous rover, near-space payloads, CubeSat prototypes, and embedded sensing platforms.

Driven by a strong interest in robotics, space systems, and low-level system design, I recently graduated as a Gold Medalist in Electronics and Communication Engineering and am currently contributing to medical device electronic systems as a Graduate Engineer Trainee at Zydus MedTech.
